name: payloadcms
description: Develop Payload CMS projects and plugins with typed configuration, safe Postgres migrations, access control, custom admin components, and layered tests.

interface.shortDescription: Build Payload CMS safely, from config through reversible migrations and tests.
interface.longDescription: A practical Payload CMS development workflow for typed collections and globals, scoped custom admin components, operation-specific access control, reusable Payload plugins, Postgres migration generation with reversible up/down validation, and a unit, integration, and Playwright E2E test strategy. It keeps environment and database targets explicit and never treats generated SQL, a passing build, or a browser screenshot as complete verification on their own.
defaultPrompt: Add a typed Payload CMS collection and global with least-privilege access control and tests.
Generate a Payload Postgres migration, inspect its SQL, and verify migrate up, down, and up on a disposable database.
Design a reusable Payload CMS plugin with custom admin components and unit, integration, and Playwright E2E tests.
